items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I gather that one New York connection was through Madelyn Moore, Al Cohn’s wife, who you met on a gig in Galveston, Texas. ... Great Neck. For dinner.

ctx.x: And you said lots of really nice things about Al, what a good person he was. Do you want to talk about him?
I remember we went out to his house, and he took me on right away. He supplied me with a lot of advice about New York.
